articles.title_en: I Don’t Trust Visual Recordings Anymore. But One Day I Will Again
articles.summary_en: In March of this year, a flurry of emails and text messages from a half dozen reporters around the world disrupted my quiet Saturday morning. An Iranian news agency had aired a week-old video of what appeared to be a U.S.-made Tomahawk missile hitting a school. News reports claimed that the strike killed more than 175 people, most of them children. The U.S. president and military denied responsibility. In the age of generative AI and all things deepfake, everyone—including me—was skeptical of the video’s authenticity. I get this type of request a lot. For the past three decades, I’ve been developing mathematical and computational techniques to analyze and detect manipulation in digital media. She works in Logan County and serves a 10-county farming area in Colorado’s northeast corner. Her job is to turn university research into practical help for the people who live there. articles.title_en: IEEE Celebrates 10 Years of Incorporating Ethics Into AI Systems
articles.summary_en: Policymakers, technologists, and members of the public have raised concerns about the harm AI’s rapid advancement might cause to society. Their concerns include bias, data privacy violations, the spread of misinformation, and losing control of AI agents. Those issues are relatively new to many people, but the IEEE Standards Association has been working for the past decade on ways to prioritize the responsible development of AI systems. In 2016 IEEE SA launched the IEEE Global Initiative for Ethical Considerations in Autonomous and Intelligent Systems (A/IS) and published the Ethically Aligned Design report. articles.title_en: Is the Galaxy S26 Ultra still a good buy at the end of 2026?
articles.summary_en: Yes, the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra remains a good buy in late 2026 if you want a large-screen Android phone with versatile cameras, an integrated S Pen, and long-term software support. The Galaxy S26 Ultra has aged very well, benefiting from Samsung’s mature hardware and software, along with a host of other quality-of-life improvements gained from its recent update to One UI 9 running Android 17. We’re going to take a deeper dive at what the S26 Ultra is, and how it compares to its cheaper siblings, in a quest to figure out whether it’s still worth your time and money this holiday season. more…

articles.summary_en: If you weren’t aware, Amazon’s full Black Friday event is in motion, and deals are flying from across countless brands, with Anker and Segway being our two headliners today. First up, the expanded Anker SOLIX Black Friday Sale has dropped the new S5000 5,024Wh Power Station back to an exclusive $2,375 low with increased savings. There’s also the increased Anker eufy security savings, too, like the 16GB or 1TB eufyCam S4 Solar Security 4-Cam Kits at lows from $950 , among many other options. Segway has also dropped its Max G3 Plus Electric Scooter to a new $1,000 low , while the Navimow i215 LiDAR Robot Mower is at a $1,329 low , with more waiting below. Of course, this is nowhere near all the amazing deals right now, which you can find all collected together in our Black Friday Green Deals
